gloss: the whole town; all over town; throughout the town

definitions.gloss: the whole town; all over town; throughout the town
definitions.explanation: The entire town or every part of it. The suffix {中|じゅう} attaches to time/place nouns to mean "throughout" or "everywhere within." Note that {町中|まちなか} (read differently) means "downtown" instead.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧うわさ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{町中|まちじゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{広|ひろ}まった→広まる：02404_hiromaru⟧。
examples.english: The rumor spread all over town.
On festival days, the whole town becomes lively.

examples.japanese: ⟦{迷子|まいご}→迷子：03729_maigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}して→探す：00493_sagasu⟧{町中|まちじゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}き{回|まわ}った→歩き回る：04605_arukimawaru⟧。
examples.english: I walked all over town looking for the lost dog.

notes:
PRONUNCIATION:
The same kanji {町中} has two readings with different meanings:
- まちじゅう: throughout the town (this entry)
- まちなか: in town; downtown area

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {町中|まちじゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{広|ひろ}まる→広まる：02404_hiromaru⟧: to spread throughout the town
- {町中|まちじゅう}⟦{大騒|おおさわ}ぎ→大騒ぎ：18301_oosawagi⟧: the whole town in an uproar
- {町中|まちじゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{探|さが}し{回|まわ}る: to search all over town

RELATED EXPRESSIONS WITH {中|じゅう}:
- ⟦{一日中|いちにちじゅう}→一日中：09519_ichinichijuu⟧: all day long
- ⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧: all over the world
- {家中|いえじゅう}: throughout the house
